papers.title: Local Nonstationarity for Efficient Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization has shown to be a fundamental global optimization algorithm in many applications: ranging from automatic machine learning, robotics, reinforcement learning, experimental design, simulations, etc. The most popular and effective Bayesian optimization relies on a surrogate model in the form of a Gaussian process due to its flexibility to represent a prior over function. However, many algorithms and setups relies on the stationarity assumption of the Gaussian process. In this paper, we present a novel nonstationary strategy for Bayesian optimization that is able to outperform the state of the art in Bayesian optimization both in stationary and nonstationary problems.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文通过引入局部非平稳性改进贝叶斯优化，虽然未直接涉及生物力学，但方法可迁移至植入物设计的昂贵仿真优化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not handle constraints, present applications to implant/biomechanics design, or demonstrate transfer to FEA-based surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化依赖平稳高斯过程假设，在非平稳问题上性能下降。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部非平稳高斯过程策略，自适应调整核函数参数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个合成和实际问题上超越现有贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准基准函数和强化学习任务进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization relies on stationary Gaussian processes, which underperform on nonstationary objective functions.
summary_en.method: A local nonstationarity strategy is introduced that adapts kernel parameters to model varying smoothness across the input space.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization on both stationary and nonstationary benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic functions and reinforcement learning tasks.

papers.title: Mechanical and Microstructural Investigation of Nickel‐Based Superalloy IN718 Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting, a quite new layer‐wise manufacturing process for metals, is used for processing the nickel‐based superalloy IN718. The objective of this work is to compare the microstructure and the mechanical properties of the produced specimens, directly after the manufacturing process and additionally after two diverse heat treatments subsequent to the manufacturing process. As the resulting microstructure and properties for specimens manufactured by selective laser melting are directional, all investigations are made for specimens oriented vertically and horizontally. Optical, scanning, and transmission electron microscopy are carried out in order to characterize the microstructure explicitly. For investigating the texture of the material, additional EBSD measurements are undertaken. Mechanical tests include tensile testing at room temperature and at elevated temperatures and hardness measurements. The investigations reveal a very good quality of the SLM‐produced specimens. Nonetheless, differences in the grain sizes, the orientation, and especially in the precipitation behavior could be found.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究镍基高温合金IN718的SLM工艺与力学性能，不涉及生物医学植入物的力学适配、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding, no LPBF fabrication for biomedical implants, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对IN718超合金微观结构与力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备IN718样品，并进行两种热处理，通过OM、SEM、TEM、EBSD表征微观结构，测试室温和高温拉伸及硬度
summary_zh.result: SLM样品质量良好，但不同取向和热处理导致晶粒尺寸、取向和沉淀行为差异
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和硬度测量验证力学性能各向异性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting parameters and subsequent heat treatments on the microstructure and mechanical properties of nickel-based superalloy IN718.
summary_en.method: IN718 specimens were fabricated by SLM in vertical and horizontal orientations and subjected to two heat treatments; microstructure was characterized by OM, SEM, TEM, and EBSD, and mechanical properties were evaluated via tensile tests at room and elevated temperatures and hardness measurements.
summary_en.result: SLM-produced specimens exhibited good quality but orientation-dependent grain size, texture, and precipitation behavior, leading to anisotropic mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through standardized tensile testing and hardness measurements.
